goal: Prevent unpredictable crashes from running out of file descriptors when IPC is enabled
Ensure the node reserves sufficient file descriptors for incoming IPC connections at startup
reviewability: Needs rebase and the author has been silent for 84 days
A review now may wait a long time for an author response
agreement: General agreement that reserving descriptors prevents confusing exhaustion failures (Sjors, sedited)
Blocking objection: a global connection limit is worse than per-listener limits on IPC endpoints (ryanofsky)
Unaddressed objection: touches P2P descriptor accounting without explanation or P2P review (ryanofsky)
Concept approval without stated reasons (w0xlt, kevkevinpal)

categories.name: ipc
why: P2 because descriptor exhaustion causes unpredictable crashes under concurrent RPC, P2P, and IPC loads
Provides an important stability fix for nodes running with multiprocess IPC enabled
